name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia keeps up mass drone strikes on Ukraine's grid; Ukraine hits Russian refineries
state: Russia launched 128 drones and two missiles overnight into 5 Nov, killing a woman in Sumy region (Kyiv Post), a day after a 310-drone attack that followed a mass strike on the power grid on 3 Nov (The Defense Post). Zelensky said on 1 Nov that attacks on energy in four regions left hundreds of thousands of families without power (Ukrainska Pravda). The 3 Nov aid-centre strike was among the war's deadliest.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice: it advises against all travel to Ukraine.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes and grid campaign = significant escalation

why: Europe's largest war since 1945 shapes European security, energy, food exports and defence budgets.
